description: Upload an image to a blog. Use the returned path as the image value when creating or updating a post, page, or blog.

blogId.description: Blog ID. Use list_blogs to discover available blog IDs.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes without a data URL prefix. Maximum decoded size: 8 MB.

filename.description: Original image filename, including its extension.

mimeType.description: Image MIME type. SVG is supported only for logo uploads.

uploadType.description: Where the image will be used. Default: post.

name: upload_image
title: Upload image
